tips.title: Smoking Impact
tips.text: Smoking increases insurance cost by 3-4x. Quitting could save you ₹454,720 annually.

reasons.detail: Smoking is the #1 cost driver, increasing premiums by 3-4x compared to non-smokers.
BMI of 25.5 is slightly above normal (25-30). Minor impact on costs.
Age 22 qualifies for lower age-based premiums.

explanation.summary: Your profile shows moderate risk factors. Standard coverage should be adequate.

recommendation.reason: Smoking habit increases health risk. Enhanced coverage advisable.
